body:
nina: quick evening handoff — summary of the TLS / edge routing incident and what's left to do

nina: around 02:12 UTC we started seeing elevated 5xxs and TLS handshake failures for traffic routed through the edge CDN cluster eu-west-edge. Symptoms: p95/p99 inference latency increased modestly (p95 +600ms), 5xx spiked to ~7% for ~22m, many clients saw TLS errors in their logs.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-198 opened and routed to eng-oncall.

nina: preliminary root cause: an automated certificate rotation job ran and uploaded a cert with the wrong SAN ordering to the CDN edge pool. Some older TLS stacks (client libraries and intermediate proxies) rejected the cert leading to handshake failures; retries caused backend saturation on healthy nodes and occasional 502/503s.

kyle: Did we see any pod/node crashes or autoscaler churn as a result?

nina: autoscaler reacted to increased latency but there were no crashes. We saw increased connection queues on proxy workers and a handful of socket timeouts on the edge side. No data corruption. We observed most failures on eu-west and a spillover to us-west via global load balancing during the window.

nina: mitigation steps executed:
- 02:15 disabled auto-rotation for edge certs (turned off rotation controller).
- 02:18 rolled back the certificate to the previous valid cert across the eu-west-edge pool.
- 02:21 increased proxy accept queue size and temporarily raised connection timeout to reduce retry amplification.
- 02:30 enabled routing fallback so traffic could be served from healthy edges (latency-tiered routing) for heavy tenants.
- 02:40 restarted the failing edge proxy instances to flush stale connections.

nina: outcome: 5xx returned to baseline by ~02:42, TLS handshake errors dropped to near-zero by 02:44. No active pages now; incident is acknowledged and being tracked.

sam: Which customers showed visible TLS errors? Any enterprise implications?

nina: observed customer impacts (from logs/support):
- logify-inc (saw TLS errors for 40 requests; retries mostly successful)
- team-docs (reported intermittent failures during the window)
- internal-monitoring (alerts tripped, non-prod noise)
No credential or token exposures. Support tickets created for affected customers. Raw logs query: https://log.redirect/redwood/queries/INC-2026-198

kyle: Any permanent failures or lost requests?

nina: small number (~15) of requests returned 502/504 and were not retried upstream. We collected request ids and attached them to the incident ticket for CS follow-up.

nina: runbook & commands used:

```
# verify cert chain on an edge host
openssl s_client -connect eu-west-edge-01.redwood.net:443 -showcerts

# check recent cert uploads
kubectl -n infra get configmap edge-cert-revisions -o yaml

# rollback cert on CDN controller
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/edge-controller -- /bin/sh -c "edgectl cert apply --id=cert-20260102-prev"

# increase proxy accept queue
kubectl -n prod patch deployment/edge-proxy -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"edge-proxy","env":[{"name":"PROXY_ACCEPT_QUEUE","value":"8192"},{"name":"CONN_TIMEOUT_MS","value":"12000"}] }]}}}}'
```

nina: monitoring to watch after handoff:
- edge_tls_handshake_failures
- edge_5xx_rate by region
- proxy_conn_queue_depth
- routing_fallback_rate

sam: Assignment for overnight shift (next 8h):
- Primary: sam
- Secondary: kyle
- Postmortem owner: nina

nina: Coverage notes: APAC shows limited coverage overnight; if errors reappear in ap-southeast, page @ops-relay for regional assistance. Also note that cert-rotation controller is disabled until the postmortem completes.

kyle: I'll validate certs across all edge pools in 10m and run an automated tls-scan across common client stacks (old openssl / jdk8) to ensure compatibility.

nina: outstanding follow-ups:
1) postmortem with timeline + cert artifact diffs (nina)
2) add cert-sanity checks to rotation pipeline (owner: infra-security)
3) update canary gating to include handshake metrics from multiple client stacks (owner: eng-platform)
4) CS outreach for logify-inc & team-docs (owner: support:liaison)
5) re-enable rotation only after postmortem and add staged rollout with compatibility checks (owner: infra)

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-198 status changed -> acknowledged by sam.

opsbot: Reminder: attach cert artifacts and log bundles to INC-2026-198 within 24h.

sam: I'll monitor dashboards for 6h and escalate if edge_tls_handshake_failures > 0.2% or edge_5xx_rate > 1%.

kyle: cert-scan results (in 12m) will be pasted to the incident ticket. If any legacy stacks fail, we'll schedule a staged reissue that preserves SAN order for compatibility.

nina: I've pinned all links and commands in the incident ticket. Handing off now  thanks everyone.

sam: Taking over. Will run periodic checks and post if anything regresses.

nina: end of handoff
